NVIDIA CUDA Runtime - cudart64_12.dll

This distribution includes the NVIDIA CUDA runtime library cudart64_12.dll,
redistributed unmodified in binary form as permitted for "Redistributable"
files listed in Attachment A of the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit End User License
Agreement (EULA):

    https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/eula/index.html

The CUDA runtime is required at load time by the DLSS 5 Neural Rendering
runtime (nvngx_dlssnr.dll), which is NOT included in this distribution and
must be obtained by the user from official NVIDIA channels.
